configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Everyday development build. Resolves the framework via COMPS_COMPOSITE_PROVIDER=auto, so it works with an installed composite (point COMPOSITE_PREFIX at it) or falls back to fetching the pinned tag.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: The build any performance measurement must use. The bare default is RelWithDebInfo (-O2 -g); this is -O3.

configurePresets.name: ci
configurePresets.description: The build gate. The fleet is warning-clean under -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic as of the CMake restructure, so warnings fail here.

configurePresets.name: asan-ubsan
configurePresets.description: The gate for the untrusted-input parse path (pkt_parser_fuzz) and the buffer/memory paths. Applies -fsanitize at directory scope, so every TU including Catch2 is instrumented.

configurePresets.name: tsan
configurePresets.description: The gate for the concurrency-dense components (psd/fft worker pools, udp_source receiver and stats threads, ws_sink server). test/race/ only has teeth under this preset.

configurePresets.name: portable
configurePresets.displayName: Release, no CPU baseline, no fast-math
configurePresets.description: Proves nothing in the fleet depends on -march=x86-64-v2 or -ffast-math to compile. Also the starting point for any future non-x86 port.

configurePresets.name: install
configurePresets.description: What the container image builds: no tests, warnings-as-errors, and the framework version pinned EXACTLY so an image can never be built against a framework nobody chose.

configurePresets.name: dpdk
configurePresets.description: Compile gate for udp_source/socket/dpdk.cpp and igmp.cpp, which are invisible to every other preset. REQUIRES a framework built with COMPOSITE_USE_DPDK=ON -- point COMPOSITE_PREFIX at it; COMPS_HAS_DPDK is detected from the framework's interface definitions, not set here. Tests off: the DPDK paths need a NIC and hugepages to run, so compile coverage is the goal.
